scope: Constructed calibrated RGB-D inputs and actual GLES/CPU fusion regression checks. This record does not evaluate the real TUM reconstruction or physical devices.

test_counts.meaning: Assertions over constructed fixtures repeated in three build/storage configurations; not independent camera recordings or a benchmark score.

configurations.command: cmake -S updated -B build-tests -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo && cmake --build build-tests --parallel 2 && ctest --test-dir build-tests -V --output-on-failure

cmake -S updated -B build-tests-asan -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DSANITIZERS=ON && cmake --build build-tests-asan --parallel 2 && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1 UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1 ctest --test-dir build-tests-asan -V --output-on-failure

cmake -S updated -B build-tests-integer -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DINTEGER_FLOAT_STORAGE=ON && cmake --build build-tests-integer --parallel 2 && ctest --test-dir build-tests-integer -V --output-on-failure

cpu_checks: Independent hand-authored little-endian packs, exact lengths, depth units and registered RGB row/channel selection.
Literal asymmetric rotation/translation and normal witnesses; GL axes; inverse supplied pose; nonidentity first pose retained for a shared held-out anchor.
Half-pixel projection, 0.5–3.5 m inclusive range and rejection counts, invalid depth, image borders and 0.05 m normal discontinuity rule.
Float64 absolute timestamps, random access, malformed calibration/pose/count/length/timestamps and invalid indices.
Weighted geometry preserves the existing first-insert RGB/radius policy.
Seven query-arithmetic checks cover a literal double-reference witness, one-ULP perturbation, material point/normal errors, nonfinite values, homogeneous components and a degenerate normal.
actual_shader_and_shared_loop_checks: Calibrated off-axis pixel witness independently fixes GL readback pixel and NDC coordinates; checks transformed position, normal, confidence and nearest-depth z-buffer.

An injected wrong model ID must raise CorrespondenceMismatch with exact frame/pixel/IDs, candidate metrics and thresholds before incrementing the comparison counter. It remains rejected after the GPU-query recheck.
Actual Fusion vertex transform feedback selects input ID3 from distinct input records and captures the literal asymmetric position/normalized-normal witness.

Controlled candidate normal texels isolate the actual Fusion strict dot comparison: one ULP below and exactly at the uploaded cutoff reject, one ULP above accepts. The uploaded uniform equals the CPU FP32 cutoff in both storage modes. This is a comparison test, not a normal-estimation accuracy result.
Actual shaders insert 165 plane points, then merge 165 noisy observations into the same 165 points at z=-1.005 m with doubled confidence; concatenating 330 raw points cannot satisfy this check.
A translated supplied-pose view adds further merges and leaves a finite metric plane with fewer points than the raw observation union.
The shared LiveFusion loop preserves a 0.125 s source interval before float conversion, then removes 165 low-confidence points at its 25th-view expiry check after 12 s of source time.
An oversized supersampled framebuffer is rejected before attachment allocation.
sanitizer_qualification: Authored C++ executables were instrumented. Mesa and GLSL shader execution were not instrumented; leak detection was disabled. No address or undefined-behaviour diagnostic occurred in these runs.
limitations: Constructed plane/input fixtures do not establish real-scene accuracy, calibration quality, tracking or general robustness.
These GPU runs use software Mesa in both storage modes; physical-device results are recorded separately.
Full-run CPU correspondence checks consume the GPU index map; the independent literal-pixel fixture here checks one calibrated index/rasterization case rather than every full-run index output.
InputFrame.valid_depth_pixels counts samples after metric range filtering; rejected_range_pixels is separate.
The query arithmetic audit is not a pose-rigidity validator; Recording separately rejects nonrigid poses.
reference_policy: Strict CPU match first. On discrepancy, capture the actual GPU vertex query, bound its point/normal arithmetic against a double reference, then require the exact CPU winner using that measured query. Any remaining mismatch throws. No distance/normal predicate or winner-selection tolerance is added.
expected_failure_fixture: The logs intentionally contain a rejected mismatch between BEGIN_EXPECTED_INJECTED_CORRESPONDENCE_DIAGNOSTIC and END_EXPECTED_INJECTED_CORRESPONDENCE_DIAGNOSTIC. Passing requires the typed exception and its diagnostic fields.
